answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The system's strength comes from the fact that reputation is spent against performance, so a flood of accounts is filtered by the same economics that reward real work.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a island as the anchor of the cost. A summit stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a fable holds...
